description: It’s time to join Team Welch at the 30th Annual Forest Park St. Patrick’s Day Parade! Parade is on Sunday, March 7. Volunteers arrive at 12:00pm, parade starts at 1:00pm Meet at the CTA Parking lot. Volunteers get a free t-shirt! Click the link to sign up! https://share.hsforms.com/14CEhGWcYRD26
